BiblicalUsage: tétartos is the word the Bible uses when it means fourth. In Matthew 14:25, in the fourth watch of the night Jesus went unto them, and it appears again in Mark 6:48.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe fourth still tells the truth about God, and I take it as it stands.
